## Design

### 2026-10-31: Finalized my ideas for the timer cube. I want to have an IMU to sense rotation and an 8x8 LED matrix to display pixel art numbers.

**2.58h**

Finalized my ideas for the timer cube. I want to have an IMU to sense rotation and an 8x8 LED matrix to display pixel art numbers.

I originally wanted to use an 8x8 NeoPixel board, but it would have been too big at around 70mm. I then found the Adafruit matrix which is only 31mm. This is perfect because of the size and because the pixels are shaped like squares, I don't have to add diffusion layers. I started modeling the cube for the neopixel matrix and I will be able to use the cube design but just smaller.

I plan to use perf board to mount the components which include: A Seeed Studios Xiao ESP32, an IMU 6050, and the Adafruit 8x8 white square led matrix and backpack. Having the backpack allows me to communicate through I2C instead of having to multiplex.

Tomorrow I plan to finalize the 3D model for the cube case and write some basic code to display numbers.
